title: RoRvsWild configuration
markdownDescription:
**RoRvsWild** is a performance and exception monitoring service for Ruby on Rails applications. It provides request tracking, background job monitoring, exception tracking, and server metrics.

This gem has **two modes:**
- **Development mode** - Free local profiling with no account required (accessible at `http://localhost:3000/rorvswild`)
- **Production mode** - Full monitoring with 30-day trace retention, notifications, and dashboards (requires API key from [rorvswild.com](https://www.rorvswild.com))

**Configuration file:** `config/rorvswild.yml`

[Documentation](https://www.rorvswild.com/docs) | [GitHub](https://github.com/BaseSecrete/rorvswild)

api_key.markdownDescription:
Your RoRvsWild API key for authenticating with the monitoring service. Get your API key by creating an app on [rorvswild.com](https://www.rorvswild.com).

**Required for production/staging monitoring.**

Run `rorvswild-install YOUR_API_KEY` to automatically configure your application.

**⚠️ Security:** Store this securely using environment variables (e.g., `ENV['RORVSWILD_API_KEY']`) instead of committing it directly.

[Installation Guide](https://www.rorvswild.com/docs/get-started/installation)

api_url.markdownDescription: URL of the RoRvsWild API that monitoring data is sent to. You should not need to change this.

timeout.markdownDescription: Timeout in seconds for HTTP requests sent to the RoRvsWild API.

ignore_requests.markdownDescription:
List of controller actions to exclude from monitoring. Use this to skip health checks, heartbeat endpoints, or internal requests that would clutter your metrics.

**Format:** `ControllerName#action_name`

**Examples:**

```yaml
ignore_requests:
  - HeartbeatController#show
  - HealthController#index
  - !ruby/regexp /SecretController/  # Ignore entire controller (YAML only)
```

**Via initializer:**

```ruby
RorVsWild.start(
  api_key: ENV['RORVSWILD_API_KEY'],
  ignore_requests: ['HeartbeatController#show', /SecretController/]
)
```

[Configuration Docs](https://www.rorvswild.com/docs/get-started/configuration)

ignore_jobs.markdownDescription:
List of background job classes to exclude from monitoring. Useful for skipping frequent maintenance jobs or internal tasks.

**Format:** Ruby constant names (class names)

**Examples:**

```yaml
ignore_jobs:
  - SecretJob
  - CleanupJob
  - !ruby/regexp /Secret::/  # Ignore entire namespace (YAML only)
```

**Via initializer:**

```ruby
RorVsWild.start(
  api_key: ENV['RORVSWILD_API_KEY'],
  ignore_jobs: ['SecretJob', /Secret::/]
)
```

Supports background job frameworks: ActiveJob, Sidekiq, Resque, DelayedJob.

[Configuration Docs](https://www.rorvswild.com/docs/get-started/configuration)

ignore_exceptions.markdownDescription:
List of exception classes to exclude from error tracking. Use this to ignore expected errors or reduce noise from known issues.

**Format:** Ruby exception class names

**Common use cases:**
- Ignore 404 errors: `ActionController::RoutingError`
- Skip validation errors: `ActiveRecord::RecordInvalid`
- Filter business exceptions: Custom error classes

**Examples:**

```yaml
ignore_exceptions:
  - ActionController::RoutingError  # 404 errors
  - ActionController::InvalidAuthenticityToken  # CSRF failures
  - ActiveRecord::RecordNotFound
  - ZeroDivisionError
  - !ruby/regexp /Secret::/  # Ignore namespace (YAML only)
```

**Via initializer:**

```ruby
RorVsWild.start(
  api_key: ENV['RORVSWILD_API_KEY'],
  ignore_exceptions: ['ActionController::RoutingError', /Secret::/]
)
```

[Configuration Docs](https://www.rorvswild.com/docs/get-started/configuration)

ignore_plugins.markdownDescription:
Disable monitoring for specific RoRvsWild plugins. Each plugin instruments a different part of your stack.

**Available plugins:**

- **ActionController** - HTTP request/response tracking
- **ActionMailer** - Email delivery monitoring
- **ActionView** - Template rendering performance
- **ActiveJob** - Background job execution (generic)
- **ActiveRecord** - Database query tracking
- **DelayedJob** - DelayedJob background processor
- **Elasticsearch** - Elasticsearch query monitoring
- **Faktory** - Faktory background processor
- **Mongo** - MongoDB query tracking
- **NetHttp** - HTTP client request monitoring
- **Rack** - Rack middleware timing
- **RailsCache** - Rails cache operations
- **RailsEngine** - Request tracking at the Rails engine level, including request queue time
- **RailsError** - Errors reported via the Rails error reporter (`Rails.error`)
- **Redis** - Redis command tracking
- **Resque** - Resque background processor
- **Sidekiq** - Sidekiq background processor
- **ViewComponent** - ViewComponent rendering

**Example - Disable Sidekiq monitoring:**

```yaml
ignore_plugins:
  - Sidekiq
```

**Example - Disable external HTTP tracking:**

```yaml
ignore_plugins:
  - NetHttp
```

[Configuration Docs](https://www.rorvswild.com/docs/get-started/configuration)

job_sampling_rate.markdownDescription:
Sampling rate for background job monitoring (0.0 to 1.0). Use this to reduce monitoring costs for high-volume applications by only tracking a percentage of jobs.

**⚠️ Warning:** Sampling may cause you to miss relevant performance issues or errors.

**Values:**
- `1.0` = Monitor 100% of jobs (default, no sampling)
- `0.5` = Monitor 50% of jobs
- `0.25` = Monitor 25% of jobs
- `0.1` = Monitor 10% of jobs

**Example:**

```yaml
job_sampling_rate: 0.5  # Track 50% of jobs
```

**Requires:** RoRvsWild gem version >= 1.7.0

[Configuration Docs](https://www.rorvswild.com/docs/get-started/configuration)

request_sampling_rate.markdownDescription:
Sampling rate for HTTP request monitoring (0.0 to 1.0). Use this to reduce monitoring costs for high-traffic applications by only tracking a percentage of requests.

**⚠️ Warning:** Sampling may cause you to miss relevant performance issues or errors.

**Values:**
- `1.0` = Monitor 100% of requests (default, no sampling)
- `0.5` = Monitor 50% of requests
- `0.25` = Monitor 25% of requests
- `0.1` = Monitor 10% of requests

**Example:**

```yaml
request_sampling_rate: 0.25  # Track 25% of requests
```

**Requires:** RoRvsWild gem version >= 1.7.0

[Configuration Docs](https://www.rorvswild.com/docs/get-started/configuration)

logger.markdownDescription:
Custom log file path for RoRvsWild's internal logging. By default, RoRvsWild uses `Rails.logger` or standard output.

**Use cases:**
- Isolate RoRvsWild logs from application logs
- Debug monitoring issues separately
- Route monitoring logs to a specific destination

**Example - File path:**

```yaml
logger: log/rorvswild.log
```

**Via initializer (for custom loggers like Syslog):**

```ruby
RorVsWild.start(
  api_key: ENV['RORVSWILD_API_KEY'],
  logger: Logger::Syslog.new
)
```

[Configuration Docs](https://www.rorvswild.com/docs/get-started/configuration)

widget.markdownDescription:
Position of the local profiler widget injected into HTML pages in development mode (defaults to bottom left). Set to `hidden` to disable the widget; the profiler remains accessible at `/rorvswild`.

In the test environment, the widget is `hidden` by default.

editor_url.markdownDescription:
URL template used by the local profiler to open files in your text editor. `${path}` and `${line}` are replaced with the file path and line number.

When not set, it is auto-detected from the `RAILS_EDITOR` or `EDITOR` environment variables (Rails 8.1+).

- VSCode: `vscode://file${path}:${line}`
- Sublime: `subl://${path}:${line}`

deployment.markdownDescription: Deployment details. Deployment tracking works automatically if the app is inside a Git repository, or deployed with Capistrano, Kamal, Heroku or Scalingo. In other cases, you can provide the details here.

revision.markdownDescription: The deployment version (mandatory when providing deployment details).

description.markdownDescription: Description of the deployment, such as a Git commit message.

name.markdownDescription: Override the host name reported to RoRvsWild. By default it is detected from `KAMAL_HOST`, `CONTAINER` (Scalingo), `GAE_INSTANCE`/`CLOUD_RUN_EXECUTION`, `DYNO` (Heroku) or the system hostname.
